A '''battle''' occurred in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces located the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Gamma Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The Rebels were forced to evacuate Hoth and flee to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==History==
===Prelude===
Shortly after the [[Battle of Toprawa]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] tracked [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in an attempt to retrieve the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] to their [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] after they were captured by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents. In an effort to keep them out of Imperial hands, Organa sent the plans to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface in the care of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. The Imperials began a search of the planet and, upon discovering the presence of a [[Anchorhead Base|Rebel base]] there, launched forces to destroy it. However, a group of Rebels were able to escape Tatooine and fled to [[Gamma Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Determined to locate the Rebels, Vader dispatched [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] to search for them.

===The battle===
After one of the probe droids arrived on Hoth, the [[Unidentified Gamma Base commander|commander]] of Gamma Base dispatched [[Rookie One]] in a [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]] to investigate, ordering him to destroy any probe droids he found. Rookie One soon confirmed the presence of a probe droid and the Rebels prepared to evacuate while the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] pursued the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] into a cave.
[[File:Not_Rieekan_and_Navander.jpg|thumb|left|The [[Unidentified Gamma Base commander|Gamma Base commander]] and a [[Unidentified Gamma Base communications officer|communications officer]] look for Rookie One]]
After destroying the probe, Rookie One brought his snowspeeder out of the cave and rendezvoused with other Rebel snowspeeders to assist in the defense of Gamma Base—[[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] were approaching the base and the Rebels needed more time to evacuate. The Rebels fought bravely against the heavily armored All Terrain Armored Transports, succeeding in bringing down two of the walkers with their [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].

As the Rebels retreated, Rookie One's snowspeeder suffered a power loss and he was unable to stay airborne. However, he told the others to carry on without him and ensure the safety of the fleeing [[Transport/Legends|transports]] while he attempted to return to base on foot. Unable to wait for the downed pilot, the commander oversaw the evacuation, leaving Rookie One alone on the planet. By the time he crossed the frozen landscape to reach Gamma Base, the base was overrun by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Rookie One fought his way through the base, eventually reaching the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] where he boarded the last remaining [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], making his escape in the nick of time as stormtroopers fired futilely after him.

[[File:GammaBase.jpg|thumb|Evacuation]]
Rookie One's departure was just in time to assist the last [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] as it attempted to escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The pilot joined up with [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ru Murleen]]'s group and the Rebels fought waves of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], keeping them away from the transport until it safely jumped out of the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Once the Rebel pilots were clear of the Imperial fighters, they followed the transport to safety.

At some point during the battle, the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]-owned ''[[StarSpeeder 1000]]'' [[Star Tours Flight 1401]], having just escaped from [[Spaceport THX1138]] with a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]] onboard from Imperial forces occupying the station, arrived at Hoth. It briefly bore witness to the final stages of the battle, and was briefly damaged by a blaster bolt from one of the AT-ATs, and narrowly avoiding being crushed by one. It eventually gained enough traction after falling off a cliff to exit Hoth.<ref name="ST:TAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

===Aftermath===
The Rebels fled to [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. However, the Imperials had captured Organa and allowed her to escape, tracking her back to Yavin 4. Unconcerned by the Imperial failure to prevent the Rebel evacuation of Gamma Base, Vader prepared for a major strike on Yavin Base itself. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Rebels would eventually return to Hoth and establish [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], banking on the idea that the Empire would not suspect the idea of the Rebels returning there.<ref name="USAToday Star Wars 2">{{WebCite|url=http://travel.usatoday.com/alliance/destinations/mouseplanet/post/2012/05/Taking-a-Trip-on-Star-Tours/685697/1|text=Taking a Trip on Star Tours|archivedate=20120507132108}}</ref> However, they were once again forced to [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuate]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] when the Imperials discovered the new base.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle made its only appearance in the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' by [[Vincent Lee]]. The game featured an original story, though many of the events were designed to be reminiscent of events shown in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Original trilogy|movies]]. The battle had much in common with the Battle of Hoth from [[1980]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and, although the planet was never identified in the game itself, both the manual for the [[Wikipedia:Sega CD|Sega CD]] version and the box for the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] version identify the ice-world featured as "Hoth".

The "ice caverns" were designed by [[Ron Lussier]], who created the branching map; initially he tried to create the tunnels as some 3D cylinders around the flying paths, but eventually made the 3D space like flying within two halves of virtual bowls. The AT-AT level was designed by artist [[Daniel Colon]].<ref name="Star Wars: Rebel Assault: The Official Insider's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault: The Official Insider's Guide]]''</ref>

The Rebel presence on Hoth in 0 BBY poses a continuity error: According to earlier sources, planet Hoth was unknown to the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] prior to the Battle of Yavin, until discovered accidentally when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] crashed on the planet.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> Another source gives a different account, that the Rebels learned the existence of Hoth by the [[Habassa]] species, also after the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing]]''</ref> In the development of the battle depicted in ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', George Lucas suggested to the Imagineers to keep the battle plan instead of a tauntauns and wampas scenario they conceived to avoid continuity issues, offering the suggestion that the Rebels and Imperial forces clashed on Hoth before, but the Empire did not expect the Rebels to return to Hoth afterwards. The staff, when hearing this from Lucas, were surprised that he was willing to sacrifice continuity for this.<ref name="USAToday Star Wars 2" />

[[File:Battle_of_Hoth-Star_Tours.png|thumb|right|250px|The Battle of Hoth featured in ''Star Tours: The Adventures Continue'']]
In the ride ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', one of the randomly chosen destinations upon escaping from Imperial forces congregated at the Star Tours space station was Hoth, which depicted a [[Battle of Hoth (1 BBY)|battle between the Rebel forces and the Imperial forces]]. As the ride's story is strongly implied to take place between 2 BBY (the founding of the Rebel Alliance) and 0 BBY (the events of ''A New Hope''), it's very likely that this was the battle depicted. The Hoth scenario, while random, is always chosen during the middle of the ride. It should also be noted that the Hoth section is the only one of the three middle scenarios (Hoth, Kashyyyk, and Tatooine) that deals with an actual combat situation.
